publisher: Cottonwood County GIS (City of Windom zoning layer, hosted by county)
filter: ZONE IS NOT NULL AND ZONE <> ''
notes: Only the City of Windom is covered; no county-wide or county unincorporated zoning district layer is published as a service. Layer is parcels categorized by primary zoning (ZONE holds district codes such as R1, R2, B1, I1, AO); parcels with blank ZONE are excluded by the filter. Source is the county ArcGIS Online organization.
